end_time.description: HH:MM 24h. end_time <= start_time means the shift crosses midnight - do not "correct" it.

function.name: shift_update
function.description: Move or edit an already-scheduled shift. Immediate - no separate approval step. Send only the fields being changed.

function.name: shift_delete
function.description: Removes a shift from the schedule. Immediate, no undo. Only call on an unambiguous, specific instruction.

function.name: availability_create
function.description: Submits a staff member's availability. Always submitted as the API key owner. Use start_time="00:00", end_time="23:59" for "available all day".

function.name: availability_cancel
function.description: Cancels/withdraws a still-pending availability submission.

function.name: timeoff_create

function.name: timeoff_cancel
function.description: Cancels a time-off request, withdrawing it regardless of its current status.

function.name: swap_post_create
function.description: Posts an existing shift for swap. A staff key can only post their own shift; a manager/admin key can post anyone's.

function.name: swap_claim_create
function.description: Volunteers for a posted shift. Blocked if the slot is already at a day-cap max, or the caller already has a pending claim on that post.
